high_level_description: The image is the seal of the United States Navy Reserve. It features a circular design with a navy blue background and gold accents. The central focus is an eagle, which is a symbol of strength and freedom in American culture. The eagle is depicted with its wings spread wide, holding a shield in its talons. The shield has a red and white striped pattern, reminiscent of the American flag, and a blue field at the top. Surrounding the eagle is a rope border, which adds to the nautical theme of the seal.
